name: stocksentry
description: StockSentry / Bundle Safety — Shopify inventory monitoring monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @stocksentry/shared && npm run build -w @stocksentry/database && npm run build -w @stocksentry/api && npm run build -w @stocksentry/worker && npm run build -w @stocksentry/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @stocksentry/shared && npm run build -w @stocksentry/database && npm run lint -w @stocksentry/api && npm run typecheck -w @stocksentry/worker
